title: Onboard aurora-13b-v2 and automate perf profiles + changelog generation
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Onboard Aurora-13B v2 to the model registry and add automated performance profile ingestion and changelog generation. Motivation: Aurora v2 has improved model architecture and new quantization variants that require validated perf profiles and clear release notes for downstream teams. This PR: adds model metadata (specs, tags, source checksums), performance profiles for A100 and RTX4090 targets across fp16 and int8 quantizations, bumps the registry schema to v2.1 to support perf_profiles, introduces a changelog generation script that composes release notes and perf diffs from model metadata, wires CI validation of perf profiles, updates docs, and adds onboarding tests. Includes a migration helper to populate perf_profiles for existing models. See commits and file list for details. Manual perf verification was performed by infra and perf teams; CI runs unit and e2e onboarding smoke tests. Linear: ENG-4521; PM-1023. Risk: schema bump requires consumers to accept v2.1; migration included to minimize disruption.
